rationale: Test a mechanistically different Core family based on intraday failed-breakdown recovery rather than pruning the rejected fixed Core.

data_contract.intraday_source: existing authorized Yahoo 1H extended panel on this branch
data_contract.bar_representation: fixed reconstructed session bars with 13:00 split; do not claim parity with original legacy 4H
data_contract.daily_context: previous completed XTKS daily bar only

candidate_family.name: FAILED_BREAKDOWN_RECLAIM
definition: candidate session low < previous completed daily low
candidate session close > previous completed daily low
candidate session close > candidate session open
candidate_family.interpretation: price breaks the prior completed-day low intraday, rejects the breakdown, and closes the session back above that level with a bullish session body

endpoint.exit: fifth official XTKS session close after entry
